name: Browser window
oneLiner: a floating browser window tilts in out of depth, the brand's domain types into the address bar, a progress line runs and the page loads as the brand's real screen, then the window drifts in 3D while a cursor glides over and clicks the call to action
say: when the speaker says where to go or names the site ('just go to...', 'it's at...'): the address types under the name, the page loads as they describe it, the click lands on 'sign up' or 'try it'
